display_information.name: Minds
display_information.description: Ask your Audiences and share Study findings in Slack.
display_information.long_description:
Minds for Slack brings synthetic-Audience research and existing Study findings into Slack conversations. Pilot validation is in progress; public installation and Marketplace availability are not open yet.

The workflow lets each person connect their own Minds account, choose an existing Audience or Study, and review a question before running research. Completed findings appear in the originating thread with a private Study link. New research uses the connected account's allowance.

Minds responds to deliberate mentions or the Ask Minds message shortcut. It does not read channel history or private Slack files. Findings posted to a conversation are visible to its members; opening the Study still requires the appropriate Minds access.

Setup, data handling and support: https://getminds.ai/guide/integration-slack
Privacy: https://getminds.ai/legal/dataprivacy
Support: hello@getminds.ai
